tools.name: qr_payload_build
tools.description: Build and validate a QR payload string for type text/url/wifi/vcard/mailto/tel/sms/geo (e.g. {"type":"wifi","ssid":"Cafe","password":"..."}). Returns the string only.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "qr_payload_build" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Build and validate a QR payload string for type text/url/wifi/vcard/mailto/tel/sms/geo (e.g. {"type":"wifi","ssid":"Cafe","password":"..."}). Returns the string…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qr_generate, barcode_generate · Private data: qr_payload_build · Public sink: qr_payload_build · Destructive: qr_generate, barcode_generate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qr_generate, barcode_generate · Private data: qr_payload_build · Public sink: qr_payload_build · Destructive: qr_generate, barcode_generate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
